productScope: Domestic, NRE and NRO callable retail fixed deposits below INR 3 crore; Table 0 (Regular) and Table 2 (Senior Citizen)

sourceReview.basis: Official AU Small Finance Bank fixed deposit interest rates page HTML. Table 0 contains 12 callable retail rows effective 1 September 2026. Table 2 contains 12 callable resident senior citizen rows effective 10 June 2026. Table 1 (Non-callable >= 1 Cr to < 3 Cr) and Table 3 (Monthly payout) are strictly excluded. Annualized yields are strictly separated from card rates. Source remains disabled pending human review and governance sign-off.

eligibilityNotes: Senior Citizen rates: Applicable strictly to Resident Indian Senior Citizens (aged 60 years and above) who maintain a banking relationship with AU Small Finance Bank.
Senior citizen preferential rates do not apply to NRE or NRO deposits.
NRE fixed deposits require a minimum tenure of 12 months 1 day. Sub-one-year slabs are not eligible for NRE deposits.
Non-callable deposits (>= 1 Cr to < 3 Cr) and monthly payout variant tables are strictly excluded from the standard callable retail dataset.
Annualized yield represents compounding effect and is strictly excluded from card interest rates.

tenures.label: 45 Months 1 Day to less than 60 Months
